summary: Russia launched a massive overnight drone and missile barrage across Ukraine, deploying Geran-5 missiles, Shahed UAVs, and Banderyol cruise missiles against Kyiv, Odesa, Kharkiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Vinnytsia, and other regions, with confirmed hits on civilian infrastructure in Kyiv and an oil refinery in Kremenchuk. Ukrainian forces struck two major Russian oil refineries in Krasnodar Krai (Ilsky and Afipsky), contributing to a reported 45% reduction in Russian refining capacity in November, and damaged a logistics bridge over the Siverskyi Donets near Stanitsia Luhanska and a repair base in Kursk region. Poland foiled a Russian sabotage operation on the Kaliningrad border designed to cause mass casualties and frame Ukraine.
key_points: Russia launched a massive overnight drone and missile attack across Ukraine with Geran-5 missiles, Shahed UAVs, and Banderyol cruise missiles hitting Kyiv, Odesa, Kharkiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Vinnytsia, and other regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78423)
Ukrainian strikes damaged two major Russian oil refineries in Krasnodar Krai (Ilsky and Afipsky), with explosions reported every 30 minutes in Krasnodar. (Source: @UkraineNow/85369)
Ukrainian forces struck a bridge over Siverskyi Donets near Stanitsia Luhanska used for Russian logistics and a repair base in Kursk region. (Source: @UkraineNow/85375)
Poland foiled a Russian sabotage operation on the Kaliningrad border intended to cause mass casualties and plant evidence of Ukrainian involvement. (Source: @UkraineNow/85373)
Russian attacks on Odesa's historic center killed 4 and injured 9 civilians in three strikes on 18 November. (Source: @UkraineNow/85374)
Russia attacked Naftogaz facilities in Dnipropetrovsk and Poltava regions; specialists are assessing consequences. (Source: @UkraineNow/85382)
EU preparing a 45 billion euro loan for Ukraine in 2027 (20bn budget support, 25bn military), repayment after Russian reparations. (Source: @UkraineNow/85376)
Next prisoner exchange to involve 1000+ personnel, prioritizing seriously ill, women, and longest-held captives. (Source: @UkraineNow/85381)

sections.executive_summary: Russia launched a massive overnight drone and missile barrage across Ukraine, deploying Geran-5 missiles, Shahed UAVs, and Banderyol cruise missiles against Kyiv, Odesa, Kharkiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Vinnytsia, and other regions, with confirmed hits on civilian infrastructure in Kyiv and an oil refinery in Kremenchuk. Ukrainian forces struck two major Russian oil refineries in Krasnodar Krai (Ilsky and Afipsky), contributing to a reported 45% reduction in Russian refining capacity in November, and damaged a logistics bridge over the Siverskyi Donets near Stanitsia Luhanska and a repair base in Kursk region. points: Ukrainian drones struck the Ilsky and Afipsky oil refineries in Krasnodar Krai overnight, both among the largest in the Kuban region, with explosions heard every 30 minutes in Krasnodar city; Reuters reports 15 of 35 major Russian refineries damaged or halted in November, cutting refining by 45%. (Source: @UkraineNow/85369, @UkraineNow/85384)

Ukrainian forces destroyed an automobile bridge over the Siverskyi Donets near Stanitsia Luhanska used by Russian forces to transport ammunition, fuel, and equipment, and struck a repair base in Russia's Kursk region. (Source: @UkraineNow/85375)

Ukraine's next prisoner exchange will involve over 1,000 personnel, with priority given to seriously ill captives, women, and those held longest, according to Human Rights Commissioner Dmytro Lubinets. (Source: @UkraineNow/85381)

Fifteen countries announced new military aid packages at the latest Ramstein-format meeting, including additional contributions to the PURL mechanism, fighter jet supplies, and enhanced air defense capabilities for Ukraine. (Source: @UkraineNow/85371)
Russian strikes hit Naftogaz energy infrastructure in Dnipropetrovsk and Poltava regions; specialists are currently assessing the damage and consequences. (Source: @UkraineNow/85382)

A magnitude 5.6 earthquake centered in Romania was felt across multiple Ukrainian regions including Kyiv, Odesa, Poltava, Vinnytsia, Kirovohrad, Mykolaiv, Cherkasy, and Dnipropetrovsk, the strongest in years. (Source: @UkraineNow/85367)

Russia launched a massive overnight attack using Geran-5 missiles, Shahed-type UAVs, and Banderyol cruise missiles against targets across Ukraine, including Kyiv, Odesa, Kharkiv, Dnipropetrovsk, Vinnytsia, Zhytomyr, and Poltava regions, with launches from occupied territories and Russian territory (Bryansk, Crimea, Kursk). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78423, @mon1tor_ua/78428, @kpszsu/97233)

Russian strikes on Kyiv caused debris falls in Pecherskyi district (fire on unfinished building, one civilian injured, hospitalized; damage to 28-story residential building at 11th floor) and Solomianskyi district (trucks burned on 180 sq.m., garage cooperative partially destroyed, no casualties). (Source: @eRadarrua/131585)

Russian forces attacked the historic center of Odesa three times on 18 November, killing four civilians and injuring nine, according to the Odesa Regional Military Administration. (Source: @UkraineNow/85374)

A chemical plant (TOV "Khimprodukt") in Naberezhnye Chelny, Tatarstan, caught fire at a pump station covering 250 sq.m., releasing dense yellow chemical smoke; two workers aged 56 and 59 suffered burns. (Source: @eRadarrua/131581)

Vladimir Putin arrived in China for a summit in Shenzhen with a "nuclear briefcase" visibly accompanied by an officer, the first public appearance of the briefcase since 2023; Xi Jinping posed with Donald Trump but did not allow Putin to stand near them in the group photo. (Source: @UkraineNow/85385, @UkraineNow/85379)
The Crimean Bridge's rail section has resumed train traffic, but the road spans and arches are completely gone, leaving minimal road capacity. (Source: @UkraineNow/85370)

Western intelligence assesses Putin plans to continue the war against Ukraine at least through winter 2026-2027, hoping for eastern advances and counting on weakened European support after 2027 elections. (Source: @UkraineNow/85377)

Russian forces launched Banderyol cruise missiles at Pavlohrad and Dnipro city in Dnipropetrovsk region, with additional missiles fired from Zaporizhzhia direction toward Dnipropetrovsk and from Dnipropetrovsk toward Kharkiv's Lozova district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78423)

Ukrainian forces struck a Russian repair base in Kursk region and destroyed an automobile bridge over the Siverskyi Donets near Stanitsia Luhanska used for Russian ammunition, fuel, and equipment transport. (Source: @UkraineNow/85375)
Russian strikes hit Naftogaz facilities in Dnipropetrovsk and Poltava regions; consequences under assessment. (Source: @UkraineNow/85382)

eRadar monitoring shows active strike UAV groups in Donetsk region (1 group), Kharkiv region (3 strike UAV groups, 2 reactive groups), and reconnaissance UAVs in Dnipropetrovsk (1 reactive group) and Kharkiv (1 reactive group). (Source: @eRadarrua/131593, @eRadarrua/131591)
Footage confirms Ukrainian strikes on a substation in Kursk city on the night of 17-18 November. (Source: @UkraineNow/85364)

Multiple reactive UAVs entered Chernihiv region from Bryansk region (Russia), tracking toward Slavutych, Honcharivske, Oster, Koriukivka, and along the Belarus border; reconnaissance UAVs also active over Kamyanske reservoir. (Source: @kpszsu/97233, @kpszsu/97235, @kpszsu/97246, @kpszsu/97243, @eRadarrua/131545, @eRadarrua/131637)

Geran-5 missiles launched from Chernihiv region toward Kyiv's Vyshhorod district and from Kyiv region toward Zhytomyr's Korosten district; reactive Shaheds from Cherkasy region toward Kyiv's Boryspil and Bila Tserkva districts and Vinnytsia's Haisyn district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78423, @mon1tor_ua/78428)
Reactive UAVs detected in northern Kyiv region (course west), on Korosten from north (Zhytomyr region), and on Dymer (Kyiv region) heading toward Kyiv. (Source: @kpszsu/97218, @kpszsu/97185)
Two UAVs detected near Stepanivka in Sumy region; reactive UAVs in northern Cherkasy region heading toward Vinnytsia region. (Source: @eRadarrua/131637, @kpszsu/97216)

Kyiv air defenses engaged multiple targets: Geran-5 on Darnytsia, reactive Shaheds on Vyshhorod, Troyeshchyna/Obolon, northern bridge, and Brovary direction; air raid alerts active 17:58-18:42 on 18 November. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78427, @mon1tor_ua/78425, @mon1tor_ua/78419, @mon1tor_ua/78422, @mon1tor_ua/78429, @eRadarrua/131547, @eRadarrua/131580)

Reactive UAVs approached Odesa region from the Black Sea toward Zatoka/Serhiivka, from the south toward Vilkove, Bolhrad, and along the coast westward past Zlatopil and toward Voznesensk and Yelanets in Mykolaiv region. (Source: @kpszsu/97260, @kpszsu/97239, @kpszsu/97257, @kpszsu/97229, @kpszsu/97244, @kpszsu/97245)
Russian forces attacked Odesa's historic center three times on 18 November, killing four civilians and injuring nine, per Odesa Regional Military Administration. (Source: @UkraineNow/85374)

Reactive UAVs targeted Mykolaiv region: Novyi Buh from south, and toward Voznesensk and Yelanets; strike UAV group active in Mykolaiv region per eRadar. (Source: @kpszsu/97202, @kpszsu/97244, @kpszsu/97245, @eRadarrua/131593)

Reactive UAVs from occupied Zaporizhzhia headed toward occupied Kherson region; strike UAV group active in Kherson region; reactive UAV circling over Zaporizhzhia city. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78428, @eRadarrua/131593)
Two reactive UAVs launched from Crimea toward Odesa region; reactive UAVs in southern Odesa region heading west. (Source: @eRadarrua/131640, @kpszsu/97214)

Russia conducted a massive coordinated overnight strike using Geran-5 missiles (multiple launches from Chernihiv, Kyiv, Kharkiv regions), Shahed-type reactive UAVs (from Cherkasy, Kirovohrad, occupied Zaporizhzhia, Crimea, Bryansk), and Banderyol cruise missiles (on Pavlohrad, Dnipro, Lozova) across at least 10 Ukrainian regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78423, @mon1tor_ua/78428)

Ukrainian drone strikes hit the Ilsky and Afipsky oil refineries in Krasnodar Krai overnight, causing continuous explosions in Krasnodar; 15 of 35 major Russian refineries damaged or offline in November, refining down 45% per Reuters. (Source: @UkraineNow/85369, @UkraineNow/85384)

Kyiv air defense engaged multiple incoming targets: Geran-5 on Darnytsia and Vyshhorod, reactive Shaheds on Troyeshchyna/Obolon, northern bridge, Boryspil, Bila Tserkva, and Brovary; air raid alert 17:58-18:42 18 November. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78427, @mon1tor_ua/78425, @mon1tor_ua/78419, @mon1tor_ua/78422, @mon1tor_ua/78429, @eRadarrua/131547, @eRadarrua/131580)

Reconnaissance UAVs active over Chernihiv region (Kamyanske reservoir, Honcharivske, Oster, Koriukivka) and along Belarus border; 2 reactive UAVs from Crimea toward Odesa. (Source: @eRadarrua/131640, @eRadarrua/131637, @eRadarrua/131545)

eRadar monitoring shows reactive UAV groups in Dnipropetrovsk (1), Kharkiv (1), Poltava (1), Chernihiv (1); strike UAV groups in Donetsk (1), Mykolaiv (1), Kharkiv (3), Kherson (1). (Source: @eRadarrua/1315
